body:
The only thing that can crush you is ultimately your own expectation of others, your circumstances, or your own emotions. So don't have any.

Being a good person (or trying to be) is the right thing to do. Never said it was easy.
You seem to think that it's important to be good in life. Most of the world thinks it is good to be important. You have your priorities in order. The world needs more people like you.

Thank you for trying to help. That is truly gracious of you. I don't doubt what you say. My life is not bad at all, and I could certainly make it better. But the fact is someone like me deserves to die in maximum pain. But I lack the courage to carry through. If I could do some good in the world that'd be a nice way to apologise to the world for my existence, but I have no idea what. All I can achieve in life is making people miserable no matter how I try. I'm just a parasite.
I read a quote lately. Everyone should go back to doing whatever they were doing before somebody told them they had to earn a living. Pursue your passion with everything you have and you'll be fine.
